note: Bangladesh tax and deduction rates used only for calculator estimates. Actual payouts depend on the issuer's rules and the investor's tax status. Not tax advice.

mutualFund.note: Dividend and capital-gains tax on mutual fund units as per applicable finance act; subject to the investor's filer status and holding period.

sonchayapatra.note: Tax deducted at source on Sanchayapatra interest where applicable. Certain small instruments may be exempt up to a threshold.

fdr.note: Tax deducted at source on FDR interest for filers; non-filers may be subject to a higher rate under the finance act.

savingsCertificate.note: Tax on savings certificate interest as per NBR rules.
